headline: Fresh Strongpoint Turns Mark Three Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, Fisherman's Row has not slackened, with fourteen strongpoint events in two hours and fifty-seven in the past day; Eidolo and Black Well again lead the active posts. Stlican Shelf, cooling at the last bulletin, is stirring once more with five fresh events and now stands divided—five Warden posts, three Colonial posts and one reduced to no-man's-land. LinnMercy is active at Lathair, and Farranac Coast, silent in the previous edition, has produced three events in the latest two-hour window. Weathered Expanse passed the last two hours without fresh changes after a forty-two-event day that carried the war's heaviest daily casualties, while Stonecradle and Mooring County have likewise paused after earlier action. The contested center remains unsettled; no side yet holds the thirty-four victory towns needed for decision.
